_comment: Legacy embedded-asset skip debt frozen at gate go-live (ADR-0545). This baseline is the shrink-only ratchet reference for the skip_* codes whose keys exist in the corpus TODAY. The live-repo gate test asserts the MEASURED skip set equals these keys EXACTLY (set equality, not a count): a NEW site triggering any skip code is born-blocking because it is not in the baseline, while frozen legacy keys age out as their sites are resolved (a tracked test target wired, a non-literal include replaced by a literal + mapping, a build-output include retired). This file is NOT producer-regenerated — it is a reviewed, hand-shrunk artifact. The anti-laundering property is REVIEW-VISIBLE, not structural (FRIC-1781112000 follow-up): because this file and the test's ceilings are same-PR-editable, laundering new debt requires a visible edit a reviewer must approve. The BLOCKING codes embedded_asset_unmapped_include and embedded_asset_policy_gate_id_mismatch carry NO baseline: any key is RED (the repo is hermetic today after the prerequisite webhook cedar-adapter BUCK fix).

_provenance.authority: ADR-0545 embedded-asset hermeticity gate go-live; door:one-way
